lawn.replaces: parking bay S2 and the resin drive south of the shorter wing

side_garden.basis: Owner (18 September): make use of the strip the shorter wing frees on the right (south) of the house. Chosen over a store outbuilding, a garden room or a carport: side garden only - lawn, planting and the tree run from the gate corner along the whole south boundary up to the garage gable, so the garage looks onto garden instead of resin. A 1 m limestone path follows the gable from the drive and continues up the wing's east wall to the east door; the lawn returns beside it. Bay S1, the gate-to-door pedestrian route and the garage door approach are unchanged.

proposalSharedLounge.location: Garden-facing first-floor room over the former garage
proposalSharedLounge.use: Shared family sitting, reading, homework and books/games storage

proposalBasement.basis: Owner (19 September): the basement runs under the whole of the new wing, and the wine cellar leaves the side wing and joins the games room, which grows to take it: cinema as before, the long east room with the media wall, pool table and the wine store at its far end, and a wine alcove behind the cinema. The north wall stays on the wing's north facade (y -4.0), 4 m from the original house's south wall and 3.4 m from the drawing-room bay, so nothing comes closer to the existing foundations than the wing itself. 21 September: straight flight along the garage wall; cinema south, wine store east, games room north, AV cupboard behind the screen.

stair.basis: Owner (21 September): a single straight flight against the garage wall instead of the dogleg in the middle of the gallery. 13 risers of 215 mm on 240 mm goings (pitch 41.9°, 2R+G 671 mm), descending east from x 5.30; the slab is cut only over the top ten treads (x 5.30–7.70), the last three treads and the landing run under it with 2.0 m headroom. The hall-to-garage door moves to the last metre of that wall (x 9.15–10.05). Below, the cinema moves south of the flight (still 5.1 m deep), the wine store beside it, the games room across the north. Owner (22 September): the flight moves 0.9 m forward (east) so there is a 0.9 m landing at the top between the wing's west wall and the first riser (x 5.30-6.20); the slab is cut over x 6.20-8.60. Below, the flight lands at x 9.08 and the cinema door moves to the cinema's east wall (hinged north, swinging in) because the north-wall door would now sit under the lower treads.

proposalBasement.technical_basis: Concept allowance for a new retaining shell, waterproofing, ventilation and supporting the ground-floor slab; detailed structure, ground conditions and escape design remain to be resolved.

specification.name: Ashley Heights — additive proposal

garageBay.upper_space: Vaulted window alcove open to the principal suite, as in proposal A

forecourt.planters: raised rendered planters with clipped box and olive trees flanking the entrance

specification.fountain: remove entire fountain and planted island

frontCentralDemolition.scope: Remove original front door, porch, arched landing window and central front wall; direct continuous entrance/landing connection
frontCentralDemolition.preserved: Existing remaining room walls, stair and floor positions

internalGarden.bayClearanceReason: Straight X10.35 glazing would cut the original western angled bay pane; returned boundary clears its shallow roof by approximately65mm and masonry by more.

specification.areaTargetStatus: Superseded by user-directed internal garden; do not enlarge wing or parking footprint to force equal area.

dormerFinish.description: Tile-hung dormer cheeks and front panels to match the existing weathered dark brown-grey roof tiles

specification.externalWallFinish: Red-brown facing brick to match the existing house in colour, texture, bond and mortar
specification.roofFinish: Weathered dark brown-grey roof tiles to match the existing house in material, colour, profile, size and coursing
specification.internalWallFinish: White painted plaster to all internal wall faces; no exposed brick internally

loftProgramme.floor_structure: New loft floor over existing rooms and side wing; support design is not inferred from the model

omitted_original_objects: Chimney
Chimney cap
Chimney pot
Chimney pot.001

sideWing.programme: Side garden living occupies the ground floor; front-east stair descends to an underground wine cellar. One bedroom, a shared family lounge/storage room and a shower room connect through former Bedroom5.

cellar.omitted: Proposal B: the wine store moves into the new wing basement

sharedBathroom.privacy_window: Existing side-west middle window at Y4.4; original aperture retained

privacy_window_objects: Proposal | Side bedrooms west window 1 glass

specification.structuralChanges: New front wing and basement; side-wing upper storey and roof; loft conversion and dormers; entrance, window, door and forecourt alterations.

proposal.areaBasis: Model geometry and supplied plan; estimates, not a measured survey
